asr_text: 11 lab sound effect cuts off abruptly, turn on looping. Looping makes a seamless loop. The ending blends into the beginning. The docs example 30 seconds of soft rain looped endlessly as ambience. Duration runs from 0 .1 to 30 seconds or auto. Too much variation, raise prompt influence. The app default is 30%. Each generation gives you four sound effects. Download your favorite. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 7.
